title: agent-ssh dtssh transport normalized registry
description: dtssh transport extension for agent-ssh's normalized registry. The live dtssh tunnel id is represented as machine.hostname because the public agent-ssh module contract exposes {hostname} to proxy_command templates.

proxy_command_binary.description: Optional absolute dtssh binary path. When omitted, module.yaml's proxy_binary_default ('dtssh') is used.

name.description: Canonical machine alias exposed to SSH clients, usually the machines.yaml key or dtssh.alias.

hostname.description: LIVE dtssh tunnel id, resolved from dtssh discover/list rather than static registry fields.

user.description: SSH user advertised by dtssh for this host.

port.description: Loopback sshd port hosted through dtssh, usually 2222.

identity_file.description: dtssh-managed client key for this alias.
